name: Model Changes
description: What changed since yesterday: compare two saved model snapshots and get a plain-language list of added, removed and modified elements, parameter value changes and counts per category. Read-only.
author: AEC Model Bridge

limit.description: Maximum number of snapshots to list, newest first.

older_snapshot_id.description: Snapshot id of the earlier state, or 'previous' for the second-newest saved snapshot.

newer_snapshot_id.description: Snapshot id of the later state, or 'latest' for the newest saved snapshot.

max_items.description: Maximum number of detailed rows listed per section; totals are always complete.
